scenes.voiceover: Can a Pune company buy its way into Europe's AI elite? They just bet one point four billion dollars.
scenes.image_prompt: Digital world map with glowing arc connecting Pune India to Munich Germany, large $1.4 BILLION BET text

scenes.voiceover: Persistent offered eighty-one euros per share for Munich's Nagarro — a staggering one hundred forty per cent premium.
scenes.image_prompt: Financial deal announcement with large euro coin showing €81, 140% PREMIUM text, corporate M&A aesthetic

scenes.voiceover: The stock market wasn't impressed. Persistent's shares crashed eleven per cent to a fifteen-month low.
scenes.image_prompt: Red stock market crash chart with -11% and 15-MONTH LOW text, bearish candlestick elements

scenes.voiceover: What are they buying? Nagarro brings a billion in revenue and eighteen thousand employees, mostly European clients.
scenes.image_prompt: Nagarro corporate profile card with Munich cityscape, $1B REVENUE, 18,500 EMPLOYEES, EUROPEAN ENTERPRISE data

scenes.voiceover: Together they become India's seventh-largest IT firm with two point nine billion in combined revenue.
scenes.image_prompt: Merger visualization showing two companies combining, $2.9 BILLION COMBINED REVENUE, INDIA'S 7TH LARGEST IT FIRM

scenes.voiceover: Wall Street can't agree. CLSA says buy at sixty-five twenty. Citi says sell at forty-ninety.
scenes.image_prompt: Split-screen bull vs bear graphic, CLSA ₹6,520 BUY in green vs CITI ₹4,090 SELL in red

scenes.voiceover: Indian IT doesn't want to be the world's back office anymore. Persistent's bet is for the front room.
scenes.image_prompt: Transformation scene showing Indian tech workers moving from cubicles to executive boardroom, BACK OFFICE → FRONT ROOM text
